description: M5Stack NanoC6 is a tiny USB-C powered ESP32-C6 devkit (23.5 x 12mm) with Wi-Fi 6, Bluetooth 5, Zigbee 3.0, and Thread 1.3/Matter support. Onboard WS2812 RGB LED, infrared transmitter, blue status LED, a programmable button, and a 4-pin Grove port. 4 MB flash.

featured_bundles.description: Power enable plus the WS2812 RGB LED entity.
featured_bundles.name: RGB LED (full setup)

featured_components.description: Load switch gating power to the onboard WS2812 RGB LED.
featured_components.name: RGB LED power enable

featured_components.description: Front panel button. Also used to enter download mode at boot.
featured_components.name: Button
